title: Partition login rate limiter and remove phantom lockout settings
description:
P0: `AddFixedWindowLimiter("login", ...)` in `MemorySmithSecuritySetup.cs` creates a single unpartitioned global bucket. Default 5 attempts/15 minutes means one person mistyping a password locks out the entire application — every user, including admins. Also a trivial anonymous DoS: 5 POSTs from anywhere exhaust the budget.

Additionally, `LockoutMinutes`/`MaxProgressiveLockoutMinutes` are exposed in Admin Settings UI with specific descriptions ("initial lockout duration... progressive lockout extends the delay") but ZERO code enforces them — phantom feature.

Scope:
- Switch to `AddPolicy("login", httpContext => RateLimitPartition.GetFixedWindowLimiter(partitionKey: httpContext.Connection.RemoteIpAddress, ...))`
- Remove `LockoutMinutes`/`MaxProgressiveLockoutMinutes` from `MemorySmithOptions.cs` and `AdminSettingsService.cs` (or implement per-account progressive lockout as a follow-up)
- Verify: 5 rapid attempts from IP A return 429; 5 rapid attempts from IP B succeed concurrently

Evidence: MemorySmith-Audit-Delta-3-20260702.md §1-2, council/audit-synthesis-council-20260705.md
